aliases.description: Gets or sets the aliases associated with the G4™ Plugin.

automation.description: Gets or sets the complete automation that the flow represents, encoded as Base64.

categories.description: Gets or sets the categories associated with the G4™ Plugin.

description.description: Gets or sets the description of the G4™ Plugin.

key.description: Gets the key of the G4™ Plugin.

namespace.description:
Gets or sets the namespace associated with the current plugin manifest.
This property is typically used to define the logical grouping of related plugins and types.

parameters.description: Gets or sets the parameters associated with the G4™ Plugin.

platforms.description: Gets or sets the platforms supported by the G4™ Plugin.

pluginType.description: Gets or sets the type of the G4™ Plugin.

projectUrl.description: Gets or sets the URL of the project.

protocol.description: Gets or sets the protocol associated with the G4™ Plugin.

source.description: Gets or sets the source of the G4™ Plugin.

summary.description: Gets or sets the summary of the G4™ Plugin.

version.description: Gets or sets the manifest version.

G4FlowManifestModel.description:
Represents the manifest of a G4™ Flow: a complete, drop-in automation published under a
namespace-qualified key so clients can discover it and send it for execution as one unit.

link.description: Gets or sets the link associated with the author.

name.description: Gets or sets the name of the author.

PluginAuthorModel.description: Represents the author of a plugin.

default.description: Gets or sets the default value of the parameter.

dependsOn.description: Gets or sets the list of parameters this parameter depends on.

description.description:
Gets or sets the description of the parameter.
Each item in the array represents a line of text, and markdown formatting is supported.

displayName.description: Gets or sets the display name associated with the object.

mandatory.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the parameter is mandatory.

multiple.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the parameter can accept multiple values.

name.description: Gets or sets the name of the parameter.

stringSyntax.description: Gets or sets optional syntax hints for the string value.

values.description: Gets or sets the list of possible values for the parameter.

type.description: Gets or sets the type of the parameter.

PluginParameterModel.description: Represents a parameter of a plugin.
